title: create:More_Structures
description: The mod added more structures for mechanical power
body:
这款模组是Create 机械动力飞越版专属拓展模组，专为原版 MC 搭配机械动力飞越版玩法打造，优化核心合成配方、新增专属道具与工具，还有多款稀有度不同的地表建筑，让飞越版的探索与机械搭建体验更丰富！
🌟 核心新增内容
1. 轻量化合成配方优化，材料获取更便捷
基础材料简化：两块原石即可合成磨制安山合金，橡木原木直接合成 32 根木棍，大幅减少基础材料制作的重复操作，适配飞越版快节奏玩法；
专属合成道具：草地方块搭配空原理图合成草地物品，安山合金块围绕苹果合成鞍山苹果，新增两款模组特色专属道具；
工具适配：新增鞍山镐、草地物品等专属工具，已纳入对应工具分类，操作体验与原版、飞越版保持一致，无缝衔接。
2. 四款全新地表建筑，主世界探索更有料
所有建筑均在主世界全生物群系随机生成，各有专属生成间距，探索节奏更均衡，稀有度梯度分明，为飞越版探索增添更多目标：
黄铜村庄：生成间距适中，探索中易遇到的常规特色建筑，丰富地表场景；
机械师小屋：生成间距稍远，含机械动力飞越版专属相关掉落，是机械玩法爱好者必探索点；
列车：超远生成间距，稀有度高，找到即是专属探索成就，提升探索乐趣；
龙子建筑：超高稀有度，生成间距极远，为深度探索增添高价值目标，满足硬核探索需求。
3. 特色方块掉落，探索有实际回报
机械师专属方块：打破后有概率掉落扳手、磨制安山合金、闪长岩等机械动力飞越版核心道具，助力机械搭建与玩法拓展；
新增建筑掉落：所有全新地表建筑打破后，可获得对应结构相关道具，让每一次探索都有实际收获。
📌 模组核心特色
专属适配飞越版：全内容围绕 Create 机械动力飞越版设计，补充道具、优化配方，完美衔接飞越版玩法与节奏；
探索体验升级：四款稀有度不同的地表建筑，丰富主世界探索维度，告别单调探索，增添更多惊喜；
玩法轻量化优化：简化磨制安山合金等核心材料合成，减少重复操作，让玩家更专注于飞越版的机械搭建与冒险探索；
全端兼容适配：单人游戏、多人服务器均可正常运行，能和好友一起体验飞越版的探索与搭建乐趣。
This mod is an exclusive expansion for the Create: Mechanical Power Overworld Edition, designed specifically to complement the original MC with the Mechanical Power Overworld Edition gameplay. It optimizes core crafting recipes, adds exclusive items and tools, and introduces several surface buildings of varying rarity, making exploration and mechanical construction in the Overworld Edition more enriching!

🌟 Key New Features
1. Lightweight Crafting Recipe Optimization, Easier Material Acquisition
- Simplified Basic Materials: Two pieces of raw stone can craft Refined Andesite Alloy, oak logs directly craft 32 sticks, greatly reducing repetitive basic material production, suitable for the fast-paced Overworld Edition gameplay;
- Exclusive Crafting Tools: Grass blocks combined with empty schematics craft grass items, Andesite Alloy blocks combined with apples craft Saddle Andesite Apples, adding two mod-exclusive specialty tools;
- Tool Compatibility: Added exclusive tools like the Saddle Pick and grass items, categorized correctly by tool type, maintaining a seamless experience with the original and Overworld Edition.

2. Four New Surface Buildings, More Engaging Main World Exploration
- All buildings generate randomly across all biomes in the main world, each with its own exclusive spawn spacing for balanced exploration pacing and clear rarity tiers, providing more goals for Overworld Edition exploration:
  - Brass Village: Moderate spacing, common special building encountered during exploration, enriching surface scenery;
  - Engineer's Hut: Somewhat farther spacing, containing Mechanical Power Overworld Edition-specific drops, a must-explore for mechanical gameplay fans;
  - Train: Very distant spacing, high rarity, discovering it counts as an exclusive exploration achievement, enhancing exploration fun;
  - Dragon Offspring Building: Extremely high rarity, very far spawning distance, adding high-value goals for deep exploration, satisfying hardcore explorers.

3. Specialty Block Drops, Exploration Provides Real Rewards
- Engineer-exclusive blocks: Breaking them has a chance to drop wrenches, Refined Andesite Alloy, diorite, and other core items from the Mechanical Power Overworld Edition, aiding mechanical construction and gameplay expansion;
- New Building Drops: All new surface buildings, when broken, can provide related structure items, ensuring every exploration has tangible rewards.

📌 Core Features of the Mod
- Exclusively Compatible with Overworld Edition: All content is designed around Create: Mechanical Power Overworld Edition, supplementing items and optimizing recipes for a perfect fit with Overworld Edition gameplay and pacing;
- Enhanced Exploration Experience: Four new surface buildings with varying rarity enrich main world exploration dimensions, ending boring exploration and adding more surprises;
- Gameplay Lightweight Optimization: Simplified crafting of core materials like Refined Andesite Alloy reduces repetitive actions, allowing players to focus on mechanical construction and adventure in the Overworld Edition;
- Fully Compatible Across Platforms: Works in single-player and multi-player servers, allowing you to enjoy Overworld Edition exploration and construction fun with friends.
